subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: On 2nd September 2023, I went to the grocery shop with a view to (a) ⎯⎯ (buy) some daily commodities. I (b) ⎯⎯ (intend) to reach home before the storm began. That’s why, I (c) ⎯⎯ (ride) my motorcycle as if I had been the boatman. But I failed. It was high time I (d) ⎯⎯ (realize) my shortcomings. Now, I am here sitting on the pavement (e) ⎯⎯ (think) of that memory. If I was more careful, I (f) ⎯⎯ (not fail) at that time. From that day on, I (g) ⎯⎯ (try) to finish all my jobs in time. I believe struggle in life (h) ⎯⎯ (make) a perfect human being. So, I always prefer (i) ⎯⎯ (learn) to (j) ⎯⎯ (teach).
guide_solution: Right form of verbs (a) buying (b) had intended (c) rode (d) realized (e) thinking (f) would not fail (g) tried (h) makes (i) learning (j) teaching
